new_partner_result.actual_application: In the square-dominant heavy branch |a|>=1/312, ||b||<=|a|, if the Schur residual has rank exactly two, shear transfer gives |mu_1|,|mu_2|>=s_*=(3-sqrt(5))/2 and the partner theorem yields ||p||_inf<668.508 without a residual leverage gate.

explicit_partner_application_example: For the unit-scale 4x4 Walsh rank-three form R diag(1,1,-1) R^T, every row has leverage 3/4 and A_ii=1/4, so |A_ii|P_i=3/16 and the partner corollary gives ||p||_inf<=35.5460107571.
